rules.rationale: Base equation of the stringVals structural embedding, defining the empty proof-domain string sequence as the empty MPY ValSeq.
Recursive equation of the stringVals structural embedding, mapping one code sequence to an MPY string value and recurring on the tail.
Execution rule for observing iteration over an embedded empty string sequence; it advances the MPY iterator protocol to #iterDone.
Execution rule for observing iteration over an embedded nonempty string sequence; it yields the head string and the embedded tail.
Base equation of the mathematical longestAcc fold, defining the result on an empty remaining sequence as the current accumulator.
Initialization equation of longestAcc, defining the first string as the accumulator when the prior accumulator is noneV.
Recursive longestAcc equation for a strictly longer head, defining the fold to replace the accumulator and continue on the tail.
Recursive longestAcc equation for a shorter or tied head, defining retention of the earlier accumulator and therefore first-on-tie behavior.
Macro expansion defining the named longestSolution proof term as the exact closure loaded from the translated solution.
